//: There was no build configuration at all. Every build was a manual local
one on one Mac, and the Android release keystore existed only on that
machine — lose it and the Play listing can never be updated again. EAS
holds the credentials, which is the actual fix for that.
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is set per profile and MUST be. lib/api throws at
startup in a non-dev build when it is missing, deliberately: the
alternative is an app that ships pointing at localhost and fails every
request on every device with no clue why.

ios.//: appleId, ascAppId and appleTeamId come from App Store Connect.
